recommendedTextbook.title: Comprehensive Data Processing for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Adedapo & E. O. Babatunde
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Data Protection Legislation and NDPR/NDPA 2023 Compliance
subtopics: The Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA 2023) and NDPR regulations
Principles of data processing: Lawfulness, fairness, purpose limitation, data minimization, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity
Rights of data subjects: Right to be informed, access, rectification, erasure ('right to be forgotten'), and portability
objectives: Explain the statutory mandates of the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC)
Audit an electronic school management platform for NDPA 2023 consent compliance
Demonstrate implementation of data subject access and erasure requests

topics.topic: Cybersecurity Architecture, Cryptography and Digital Forensics
subtopics: Symmetric encryption (AES) vs asymmetric encryption (RSA, public/private keys)
Digital signatures, SSL/TLS certificates, and cryptographic hash functions (SHA-256)
Digital forensics: Incident response, chain of custody, evidence preservation, and log file analysis
objectives: Differentiate symmetric from asymmetric encryption algorithms
Explain how digital certificates verify the identity of HTTPS web servers
Maintain a legally admissible chain of custody during a cyber-intrusion investigation

topics.topic: Web Design Technologies: HTML5, CSS and Responsive Layouts
subtopics: HTML5 semantic elements: header, nav, section, article, aside, footer
CSS styling: Selectors, box model (margin, border, padding, content), Flexbox, CSS Grid
Responsive web design and mobile-friendly media queries
objectives: Code a valid semantic HTML5 web page structure
Style web elements with CSS rules controlling typography, colors, and layout positioning
Apply CSS media queries to ensure proper layout rendering on smartphones and tablets

topics.topic: Big Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence and Automation
subtopics: Characteristics of Big Data: The 5 Vs (Volume, Velocity, Variety, Veracity, Value)
Machine Learning algorithms: Supervised vs unsupervised learning models
Societal impacts: Automation, algorithmic bias, future of work, and AI ethics in developing nations
objectives: Identify the 5 V characteristics of contemporary big data streams
Compare supervised image classification with unsupervised cluster analysis
Debate ethical considerations regarding biometric surveillance and automated decision-making
